sql: SELECT id, name, row_number() OVER () FROM s.t
SELECT id, val, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY flag ORDER BY val DESC) AS rnk FROM s.t
note: OVER with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY DESC — rank()

sql: SELECT id, val, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY val), percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY val), cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY val) FROM s.t
note: dense_rank, percent_rank, cume_dist — multiple window funcs

sql: SELECT id, qty, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY qty) FROM s.t
SELECT id, val, lag(val, 1, 0::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY flag ORDER BY id), lead(val) OVER (PARTITION BY flag ORDER BY id) FROM s.t
note: lag with offset+default and lead — PARTITION BY ORDER BY

sql: SELECT id, val, first_value(val) OVER w, last_value(val) OVER w, nth_value(val, 2) OVER w FROM s.t WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY val ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
note: named WINDOW clause; first_value, last_value, nth_value with ROWS frame

sql: SELECT id, val, sum(val) OVER (PARTITION BY flag ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM s.t
note: aggregate sum as window fn; ROWS frame with n PRECEDING and CURRENT ROW

sql: SELECT id, val, avg(val) OVER (ORDER BY val RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM s.t
note: RANGE frame UNBOUNDED PRECEDING to CURRENT ROW — avg aggregate as window fn

sql: SELECT id, qty, sum(qty) OVER (ORDER BY qty GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) FROM s.t
note: GROUPS frame with EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW

sql: SELECT id, val, row_number() OVER w2 FROM s.t WINDOW w1 AS (PARTITION BY flag), w2 AS (w1 ORDER BY val)
note: reference window — w2 inherits from w1

sql: SELECT id, val, sum(val) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP), count(*) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES), min(val) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM s.t
note: ROWS frame with EXCLUDE GROUP, EXCLUDE TIES, EXCLUDE NO OTHERS

sql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM s.t
note: error: UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING as start frame bound is invalid syntax

sql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM s.t
note: error: invalid frame bound — CURRENT ROW to UNBOUNDED PRECEDING is not a valid frame
